native_test_entries: test1: {'time': 4.3, 'state': {'led1': 'on', 'led2': 'off', 'led3': 'off', 'rgb1': 'red', 'servo1': 0, 'servo2': 0}, 'description': 'First test at 4.3 seconds. The servo motors are at 0-degree position after the initial 2-second pause. LED1 is on (first in sequence), RGB LED shows red (synchronized with LED1), and servos are at 0 degrees.'}

test2: {'time': 8.3, 'state': {'led1': 'off', 'led2': 'on', 'led3': 'off', 'rgb1': 'green', 'servo1': 180, 'servo2': 180}, 'description': 'Second test at 8.3 seconds. The servo motors have swept to 180-degree position and paused for 2 seconds. LED2 is on (second in sequence), RGB LED shows green (synchronized with LED2), and servos are at 180 degrees.'}

test3: {'time': 12.3, 'state': {'led1': 'off', 'led2': 'off', 'led3': 'on', 'rgb1': 'blue', 'servo1': 0, 'servo2': 0}, 'description': 'Third test at 12.3 seconds. The servo motors have swept back to 0-degree position and paused for 2 seconds. LED3 is on (third in sequence), RGB LED shows blue (synchronized with LED3), and servos are at 0 degrees.'}
assumptions: Convert numeric test time to milliseconds; apply changed controls 400ms before observation unless explicit hold duration exists.
Normalized potentiometer positions0..1 map to ADC0..1023.
Every inferred button press is released after200ms unless an explicit hold duration is supplied.
Reference preflight required; no claim that reference consistency proves all prose requirements.
For continuous 90-degree/s sweeps, a 20 ms PWM control frame adds up to 1.8 degrees of sampling delay to the prior two-degree allowance. The disclosed tolerance is four degrees.
test_origin: manual_requirement_derived_supplement; retained original test plan is unchanged
